title: All the Bright Places
author: Jennifer Niven
engineRationale: Fiction with no specific real people to depict — the story lives inside two teenagers' inner lives (mental illness, suicidal ideation, grief). Antidote's flat-vector everyman rig + kinetic typography portrays interior/psychological states honestly and renders CPU-cheap, where photoreal Flux cut-outs of nameable figures (Vox) have nothing real to show.
